text.text_excerpt: What a gorgeous bar! As soon as I walked into Vive, I knew it was high class. The bar is beautifully lit with Vive's signature purple. The bartenders were very friendly, as well. I love that there is a nice lounge area on the inside part of the bar. It would be a great place to enjoy happy hour. Outside is lovely. It's a hotel, so there is a small pool, as well as a patio with plenty of seating. There is a beautiful garden surrounding the pool area that makes you feel as if you are on vacation in another city. WIth the open patio you can enjoy the sun, or admire the night, after the sun goes down. Vive is located just a few doors down from one of my favorite restaurants, Oceana, so I can ...

If you've seen my profile recently, you'll notice that I've been bar hopping all over NOLA! Happy to say that Vive! does NOT disappoint! Who would've known that this quiet and quaint little lounge was right off the loud, obnoxious streets of the French Quarter. Especially right near Bourbon! Vive is located in Hotel le Marais and is pretty much catered towards the hotel guests. I came with a friend on a Saturday night, and it wasn't busy at all. And honestly, no one outside of the hotel would even know of Vive if it weren't for Yelp! I immediately fell in love with the ambiance. The lighting is just perfect, and the outdoor pool with comfortable lounge seating is just the icing on the cak...

When I first walked into Vive! (to meet up with Yelpers for an afterparty for the July Elite event) I was impressed with the layout and lighting. Vive! has only recently opened, in April if memory serves, but already has a good ambiance and a great bartender. He made a mean Sauzerac. The outside section is a small courtyard with it's own small bar (which wasn't open when we were there) and seating near the hotel's small, heated salt water pool. I don't spend much time in the French Quarter, but next time I'm in the area Vive! is definitely on the list of places to visit.
